# Personal Hub

> A calm, local-first toolkit for projects, weekly planning with sub-tasks, daily logs, content ideas, product feature tracking, job search tracking, outreach templates, and template links on cold emails and outreach.

Personal Hub is an installable PWA that stores user data in the browser with IndexedDB (via Dexie). It has no required account, backend sync, or analytics pipeline for user content.

## Site

- Production URL: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com
- Source: https://github.com/lakshay2425/personal-hub
- Sitemap: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://hub.lakshaymahajan.com/robots.txt
- Data reference (schemas, exports): https://github.com/lakshay2425/personal-hub/blob/master/DATA.md

## Public Routes

These are crawlable app shell / marketing pages. Dynamic IDs in URLs (e.g. project or company detail) contain no server-hosted user data.

- `/` — Landing page overview
- `/projects` — Project list and question inbox
- `/projects/[projectId]` — Project detail (Questions, Content Ideas, and Features tabs)
- `/content-ideas` — Standalone content ideas
- `/content-ideas/calendar` — Content calendar (schedule ideas by date)
- `/planner` — Weekly task planner (Today / Backlog / Upcoming tabs, sub-tasks, drag reorder, Logger integration)
- `/logger` — Daily log entries
- `/logger/dashboard` — Date-filtered log review
- `/job-search` — Dashboard (stats, activity, follow-ups)
- `/job-search/companies` — Company list
- `/job-search/companies/[id]` — Company detail
- `/job-search/leads` — Email and other leads (copy email, company info modal, follow-up template links on Email channel)
- `/job-search/outreach` — LinkedIn and X outreach (overflow menu: open profile, edit, delete; separate LinkedIn/X profile URLs)
- `/job-search/applications` — Applications
- `/job-search/cold-emails` — Cold emails (outreach + follow-up template links)
- `/job-search/templates` — Outreach message templates (cold email, LinkedIn, X DM, follow-up)

Legacy redirect: `/questions` → `/projects`.

## Tools & Capabilities

### Projects
- Question inbox and project organization with titled answers
- Sub-question hierarchy (max depth 2: root → sub → sub-sub)
- Drag-and-drop reorder among siblings; move questions between projects/inbox
- **Features tab** (per project): track product features by version and status (Idea / Planned / In Progress / Done / Dropped); inline version creation from feature form; filter by version, status, and title search
- Deleting a project cascades to its features and versions (content ideas: delete or orphan)
- JSON export/import (full overwrite)

### Content Ideas
- Standalone (`/content-ideas`) or per-project (tab in project detail)
- Sub-idea hierarchy (max depth 2), drag-and-drop, reparent via overflow menu
- Status: Draft / Ready / Published; published links (LinkedIn, Twitter, blog, other)
- View modes: table, cards, list (persisted in localStorage)
- **Content Calendar** (`/content-ideas/calendar`): schedule ideas by date; month/week views; status colour dots (Draft grey, Ready amber, Published green); planning only — no auto-posting
- Activity log for lifecycle events
- Included in Projects JSON export (not a separate export)

### Planner
- Monday-based weekly task planner with **Today**, **Backlog**, and **Upcoming** tabs
- Week navigation on Today (prev/next, "This Week")
- Sub-task hierarchy (max depth 2: root → sub-task → sub-sub-task), collapsible groups
- Drag-and-drop reorder among siblings; manual `sortOrder` (priority badge is informational only)
- Edit, delete, and add sub-tasks via three-dot overflow menu; read-only notes modal from notes icon
- Tasks with priority (High / Medium / Low), optional notes with voice input
- Parent tasks with sub-tasks show `X/Y` progress badge; checkbox disabled until sub-tasks drive completion
- Backlog for incomplete past-week tasks; "Move to This Week" (moves entire subtree)
- Completing a leaf or sub-task auto-creates a separate Logger entry for today with `source: "planner"`; parent auto-completes silently when all descendants are done
- Activity log audit trail (Task Created, Sub-task Created, Completed, Moved, Deleted)
- Included in Projects JSON export; older backups backfill hierarchy fields on import

### Logger
- Multiple timestamped entries per calendar day
- Dashboard view to filter entries by date
- Future dates blocked on add/edit forms
- JSON export/import

### Job Search
- Companies, leads, outreach (LinkedIn/X), applications, cold emails, outreach templates
- **Templates** (`/job-search/templates`): reusable messages by type (Cold Email, LinkedIn Message, X DM, Follow-up); card grid, type filters, search, copy body to clipboard; placeholders `{{name}}`, `{{company}}`, `{{role}}` highlighted in preview; no auto-send
- **Template linking**: cold emails and outreach leads store `templateId` (outreach message) and `followUpTemplateId` (follow-up message); email-channel leads store follow-up template only (initial outreach tracked on cold emails)
- **Leads** (`/job-search/leads`): Email and Other channels; click email to copy to clipboard; click company name to open read-only company info modal; follow-up **dates** on Email leads only; follow-up **templates** on Email leads
- **Outreach** (`/job-search/outreach`): LinkedIn and X channels; separate `linkedin` and `xProfile` URL fields; three-dot overflow menu with Link (opens profile), Edit, Delete
- Dashboard with time filters (today, 7/30/90 days, all time)
- Global search across entities
- Company detail pages; creatable selects for sector/role/type
- Voice-to-text input on forms (Web Speech API)
- Activity logs per entity type
- JSON export/import (version 5; `xProfile` on leads; older backups backfill on import)

## Data Storage

Three separate IndexedDB databases (Dexie):

| Database | Dexie name | Feature |
|----------|------------|---------|
| Projects & Content Ideas | `question-hub-db` | Projects, questions, answers, content ideas, planner tasks, project features, versions |
| Logger | `logger-db` | Daily log entries |
| Job Search | `job-search-tracker-db` | Companies, leads, applications, cold emails, templates |

All user content stays on the device. Export/import is manual JSON backup — there is no cloud sync.

For full schemas, migration history, and export JSON shapes, see DATA.md in the repository.

## PWA

- Installable via web app manifest (`display: standalone`)
- Service worker (Serwist) caches app shell and visited routes for offline use
- IndexedDB read/write works offline once the JS shell is cached
- Uncached offline navigations fall back to `/~offline`

## Tech Stack

Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Dexie, Zod, react-hook-form, @dnd-kit, Serwist, react-hot-toast.

## Notes For Assistants

- Treat all user-created app data as local browser data, not server-hosted public content.
- Do not infer public project, company, lead, application, or log records from dynamic routes — those pages render empty shells until the user loads their local IndexedDB data.
- Prefer the sitemap for crawlable public pages.
- When answering schema or export-format questions, refer to DATA.md rather than guessing field names.
- Job Search template links use `templateId` and `followUpTemplateId` on `leads` and `coldEmails`. Leads have separate `linkedin` and `xProfile` fields (Dexie v5). Template records live in the `templates` table.
